notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The demo has been updated!

- Added additional lore related notes.
- Changed sounds
- Trigger frequency

Fixed:
- Item display bug in inventory.


We will be glad to receive your feedback!

notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
We've got good news!
The demo has appeared in Steam on the main page of the app!

Also changes have been made:

1. Added functionality to discharge torch batteries. Now you need to look for batteries to avoid finding yourself in total darkness.

2. Added additional elements reacting to the presence of the player.

3. Changed models, textures, sounds, lighting.

4. Redesigned UI interface.

5. Hotfixes and bug fixes.

We are waiting for your feedback and suggestions on improving the game!


Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Development continues!
notes.notes:
List of added mechanics implemented so far:

- A terrible and mysterious statue. No one knows where it came from, but everyone who passed by it assured that it seemed to be watching you. When our main character gets into the statue's field of vision, it chooses him as a target for hunting. The statue will constantly watch you, interfering with your movement in every possible way.

- Puzzles. Massive doors hiding secrets in the dark. Many will be closed with ordinary keys (which will need to be found), while others will have complex mechanisms and to open such a door the player will have to solve riddles with pressure plates, buttons, etc.

- Beware of the darkness. Watch your movements because in the dark you can fall into the abyss. Death from falling is implemented.

- Column of the goddess of safety. At first it may seem that the column is creepy, but in fact it will help the main player maintain his sanity. Just approach her and the goddess will save your game process.

- Inventory. The game will have a simple and convenient inventory, where the character can view all his finds, keys, flashlights, relics, ancient artifacts and much more.

- Archaeologist's diary. What happened to the protagonist's colleagues? Why does he hear their voices but not see them? Only excerpts from the diary can shed light on this mystery. Also, notes can give hints on solutions to various puzzles. The character also has his own journal, where he can reread the found notes and diaries.

- Voices in the dark. Do you hear them too? During the game, the player will experience a feeling of persecution, as if invisible shadows are watching him. Sounds, music, voices - all this will mix into a terrible dissonance, what is true and what is a lie is up to you to decide.

Thank you all for adding the game to the wishlists. Your support is very important to us!

...

Respectfully yours
ZTS_Studio
